description: Actual gate-departure UTC minute equals scheduled gate-departure UTC minute plus departure delay modulo 1440.
rationale: DEP_DELAY is explicitly the signed difference between actual and published gate-departure times, while both clock columns are minute-of-day values and therefore require modulo-1440 arithmetic across midnight.

description: Wheels-off UTC minute equals actual gate-departure UTC minute plus taxi-out duration modulo 1440.
rationale: TAXI_OUT is the elapsed interval from leaving the gate to wheels-off, so adding it to the actual departure clock gives the takeoff clock, including midnight wraparound.

description: Wheels-on UTC minute equals wheels-off UTC minute plus airborne duration modulo 1440.
rationale: AIR_TIME is defined as the elapsed interval between wheels off and wheels on, so the corresponding clock equation is modulo 1440 because the columns contain minute-of-day only.

description: Actual gate-arrival UTC minute equals wheels-on UTC minute plus taxi-in duration modulo 1440.
rationale: TAXI_IN is the elapsed interval from runway landing to the destination gate, so adding it to the landing clock yields the gate-arrival clock with modulo-1440 wraparound.

description: Scheduled gate-to-gate elapsed time equals scheduled arrival UTC minute minus scheduled departure UTC minute modulo 1440.
rationale: CRS_ELAPSED_TIME is the scheduled interval between the two scheduled gate events, while the schedule clocks are minute-of-day values that require modulo arithmetic for overnight flights.

description: Actual gate-to-gate elapsed time equals actual arrival UTC minute minus actual departure UTC minute modulo 1440.
rationale: ELAPSED_TIME is the interval from actual gate departure to actual gate arrival, and both endpoint clocks are minute-of-day values, so overnight trips use modulo-1440 subtraction.

description: Actual gate-arrival UTC minute equals scheduled gate-arrival UTC minute plus arrival delay modulo 1440.
rationale: ARR_DELAY is explicitly the signed difference between actual and scheduled destination gate-arrival times, while the endpoint columns are minute-of-day clocks requiring modulo-1440 arithmetic across midnight.
